QUOTE: Otherwise it XORs with `mbedtls_ct_zero`, which is declared `volatile` in `constant_time.c`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque` falls back, when inline asm is unavailable, to XOR-ing with the volatile global `mbedtls_ct_zero`. That names the global and describes the same-function fallback.
